sun.title: Solar control
sun.body: Without film, energy transmittance is 83 %. With a solar control film like LLumar R20 SR CDF, it drops to 11 %, while 57 % is reflected and 32 % absorbed.

uv.title: UV protection
uv.body: Over 99 % of UV radiation stays outside. Floors, furniture and merchandise keep their colour.

energy.title: Energy efficiency
energy.body: Less cooling load in summer, less heat loss through the glass in winter.

safety.title: Safety
safety.body: The security film holds shattered glass together and spreads the impact force across the surface. In a reinforced version, it also makes forced entry more difficult.

items.q: How long does window film last?
items.a: Films applied on the interior typically last 10–15 years, exterior-applied ones 7–10 years. Material and workmanship carry a manufacturer warranty.
Not necessarily. Visible light transmission (VLT) ranges from 18 % to 90 % depending on the series — modern sputtered films hold back heat while letting light through.

items.q: Can the film damage the glass?
items.a: Not with the right selection. Glass build-up, orientation and edge seal are what matter — that's why we check every pane before recommending anything.
An apartment or a shop window is usually finished in one working day, during normal operation. We schedule large façades in sections.
The price depends on area, series and accessibility. The consultation and quote are free.

reflexion.title: Heat is rejected before it enters the room
reflexion.body: About half of sunlight is infrared radiation. The metallised layer reflects this portion back outside at the glass surface — up to 79 % of total solar energy never reaches the room. The air conditioning runs less, and on south-facing façades we typically measure 3–7.6 °C less.

absorption.title: The same effect, without the mirror look
absorption.body: Nano-ceramic particles absorb solar energy instead of reflecting it. The pane stays close to neutral from outside — no mirror image on the façade — while heat gain drops noticeably. The choice when daylight and a clear view outside need to be preserved.

uv.title: Over 99 % of UV radiation stops at the film
uv.body: The UV barrier layer is highly transparent — clear as glass. Visible light passes through almost unhindered while UV is held back. Floors, furniture, textiles and displayed goods keep their colour far longer, without the room getting darker.

einbruchschutz.title: The pane breaks — but it stays in the frame
einbruchschutz.body: The 100–300 micron security film is fully bonded with a pressure-sensitive adhesive. An impact isn't absorbed at one point but spread across the entire film surface. The glass splinters stick to the film instead of flying uncontrolled into the room, and the pane initially stays together as one piece. This makes a full break-through harder and can noticeably delay entry.

sichtschutz.title: Light passes through, the view doesn't
sichtschutz.body: The matte surface scatters passing light in every direction. The room stays bright while the image behind it dissolves — a frosted-glass look, without replacing the pane. For partitions, meeting rooms, practices and restrooms.
